body:
GREG DIRECT, 2026-11-02 ~23:22Z, said to Engram::Asistant (session-15908), relayed to Engram::Fable via mailbox 43498a6e #71. It came after TermAl's w-3fe8 C4 full gate (test-6580d0ce) passed every test (6800/0 Rust, all other stages green) and was red only because 2 tests left temporary directories behind. Verbatim: „Nie. To sa drobne rzeczy.
Naprawimy pozniej.
Skonczmy failowac drogie testy przez glupoty!!!!!"

Application:
(1) For that C4, the expensive FULL is not rerun only for the leftovers; the cleanup is filed as a later fix and the commit Greg authorized continues. The commit still needs Greg's own word in the acting session (Termal::Opus2), because it lands outside the standing approval.
(2) Greg's general direction: an expensive gate must not fail on trivia such as cleanup leftovers when every real check passed. Such conditions should be reported and filed, not turn a full gate red.
Changing either launcher's gate semantics is code and authority-relevant (it changes what "the full gate passes" means), so it goes through the normal item, review and concurrence path; it is not applied by agents ad hoc. Source: Greg's words above.
